### ❌ Enter Loadings (ACB-3599) › AC07: Per Mille loading > $20.00 → maximum-per-mille error

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC07: When I enter a per mille loading greater than 20.00, Then error "The maximum per mille loading is $20.00".
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, price Life $200k, open Loadings. 2. In an enabled Per Mille field (Life), enter 20.01. 3. Blur/OK.
> 
> Expected: "The maximum per mille loading is $20.00".

**Assertion failure:**
